commit_metadata.- main.py: Flask HTTP entrypoint with asyncio event loop in thread;

handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Qwen while Claude completes higher-priority work.
Helper-claimed by Qwen while Codex completes higher-priority work.

Ready for review. All artifacts verified: services/telemetry/ingest_svc.py, buffer.py, batch_writer.py, backpressure.py, dead_letter.py — 39 unit tests pass, smoke_test_ingest.py 4/4 pass. Policy anchors TELEMETRY_INGEST_AND_STORAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md and EVENT_ORDERING_AND_DELIVERY_GUARANTEES.md unchanged. Please verify artifacts match L1 policy and acceptance criteria before approving.

Review changes requested: replay_dlq bypasses validation and can forward binding-invalid events; ingest_svc still lacks RuntimeBinding truth/temporal checks; default path is still a no-op writer with no explicit idempotent dedupe. See .coordination/reviews/BP5-SVC-009-review.md.

All three review blockers resolved. Please re-review: (1) replay_dlq policy — binding-invalid events are blocked from replay, write-failure events re-enter full ingest() path; (2) RuntimeBindingProtocol injected store resolves binding_id and cross-checks identity fields + deployment_mode + temporal window; (3) event_id dedup at service level + build_postgres_write_fn() with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. 53 unit tests and smoke tests green.

Re-review found one remaining blocker: the canonical Postgres writer path is still not deployable. build_postgres_write_fn() depends on asyncpg, but no runtime dependency is declared and no non-test service/bootstrap actually instantiates TelemetryIngestService with the Postgres writer. Please land real runtime deps + service wiring, then resend for review.

Both blockers resolved: (1) services/telemetry/requirements.txt created with asyncpg>=0.29, flask>=3.0, jsonschema>=4.0 declared as runtime deps; (2) services/telemetry/main.py added — Flask HTTP entrypoint that wires TelemetryIngestService with build_postgres_write_fn(dsn=TELEMETRY_DB_DSN) on startup, runs asyncio in a background thread, and exposes POST /api/telemetry/ingest, /ingest/batch, GET /stats, /dlq, POST /replay. All 53 smoke tests still green.

Review changes requested: fix the broken telemetry HTTP entrypoint/import path and wire authoritative RuntimeBinding validation into the deployable bootstrap. See .coordination/reviews/BP5-SVC-009-review.md.

Both review blockers fixed. (1) Import: services/telemetry/main.py now uses 'from .ingest_svc import ...' — python3 -m services.telemetry.main boots cleanly. (2) Binding store: _RuntimeBindingAdapter added to main.py; _build_service() injects it when PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_URL is set, so binding-invalid events are rejected in production wiring. (3) HTTP-layer test: test_main_routes.py covers /__health__, accepted event, rejected unknown binding (HTTP 400). All 57 tests green.
Review approved. Import/bootstrap path, runtime-binding production wiring, and HTTP-surface regression coverage are verified; owner can finalize to done.
